scope: deterministic synchronous single-instance S1 kernel for ordinary PR merge

status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_IN_MEMORY: Specified narrow behavior exists and is examined in the synchronous model only.
status_definitions.PARTIAL_IN_MEMORY: Some local behavior maps; essential general or real-adapter conditions are absent.
status_definitions.UNSUPPORTED_IN_S1: The concrete S1 API/state lacks this capability; not a claim about all Record roadmap or host products.
status_definitions.DESIGN_ONLY: Present in unified proposal; not executed by S1.

objects.s1_representation: one action object with one reservation and modeled sent transition; no separate business intent and physical request identities
strict ordinary-merge evidence nested in a completion; one current completion; raw command events retain repeated observations
Recorded can be derived from journal/completions history; dependency historical-completion checks a currently valid completion
result ID hashes whole merge spec + mergeSha; global available defaults true until markUnavailable

binding_notes: acceptanceRevision is a submission-concurrency version: accepted stores the old value, then task increments it. dependency does not compare the accepted value with the current counter.
resultId includes immutable spec+mergeSha in the narrow merge domain; absent explicit artifactVersion is not by itself a failure.
Fixed built-in policy can be modeled as constant only within this exact interpreter and trust contract. Mutable policy, time, principal and consumption q inputs are not implemented.

objects.s1_representation: sourceId/active/revision; actor role and flat actorId supplied by trusted caller
reserveAction and dispatchAction synchronous transitions; checkAction is only new-action precheck
no target implementation; verifier supplies observation or proof booleans
in-memory command journal with schemaVersion 1; snapshots include stream/cursor/digest; no storage

cases.mapping: A completed task cannot be revised in place. Use the catalog successor variant; a related new assignment has a new taskId, specVersion=1 and no inherited acceptance.

existing_test_evidence.name: record spec revisions reject earlier evidence and need a new authorization source
record old result button cannot accept a corrected different result

limitations: No generic task outcome or mutable acceptance-policy API.
The successor relation is only relatedTaskId; it is not automatic evidence reuse or a lineage-aware v2 transfer.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Declare mutation_mode=reject_then_explicit_successor and map the new definition to a new task identity; do not expect a completed S1 task to become v2 in place.
cases.catalog_title: 相关规格变更使旧验收失去当前适用性

cases.mapping: Notes increment task revision but do not change the result token vector or dependency predicate inputs.

existing_test_evidence.name: record acceptance uses immutable result binding while unrelated notes stay valid
R2-S02 control same-history result tokens and submitted requests survive JSON replay

limitations: The existing test adds the note before acceptance and proves the shown token remains usable; source inspection also shows post-acceptance notes do not change dependency inputs.
No policy, clock, audience or authorization-expiry input exists in this S1 rule.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Document the S1 rule read set. Adding policy/time/consumer dependencies later requires explicit versioning; the old short vector is not generally sufficient.
cases.catalog_title: 无关备注不使验收失效

cases.mapping: S1 has a single current completion, not a finite AND/OR support graph. Same-result verification returns the existing completion.

existing_test_evidence.name: record wrong completion suspends acceptance and same result needs explicit reuse

limitations: Distinct observationRef strings are only synthetic observations; S1 does not represent independent authority or OR support.
The second observation remains in the command journal, but it is not an alternative active witness.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Implement an explicit support formula and complete dependency extraction before applying the P5 DAG proof or claiming C03.
cases.catalog_title: AND/OR 支持撤回后的语义正确性

cases.mapping: No support-edge insertion or cycle-checking API exists. Rejecting an unknown command is not a support-cycle implementation.
limitations: relatedTaskId is an assignment link, not a proof-support edge.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Do not adapt task links into support semantics. Add typed support relations with explicit finite-acyclic admission before claiming C04.
cases.catalog_title: 首版拒绝自支持验收循环

cases.mapping: Withdrawal may restore A to unknown while B stays reserved. Dispatch checks other active actions again using the same repository/ref key.

existing_test_evidence.name: R2-S01 final admission blocks an existing reservation after another success is withdrawn
R2-S01 control terminal proof releases the original reservation after replay

limitations: One synchronous RecordKernel instance only. No network sender, target fence, multi-process transaction or cross-stream conflict lock.
checkAction includes the caller task own reservation and is a new-action precheck; it is not the final dispatch predicate.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Keep all conflicting actions in one authority domain and serialize conflict scan plus reservation/dispatch publication. Bind a real outbound operation to this exact dispatch boundary.
cases.catalog_title: 纠错后再次检查已预留动作的冲突

cases.mapping: Cancel aborts unsent reservations and leaves sent/unknown actions occupied. not_applied requires two true proof fields plus a reference.

existing_test_evidence.name: record unknown sent action cannot be replaced after cancellation and reissue
R1-P2 correction: only terminal not-applied proof releases the corrected action

limitations: cancel after sent leaves status sent until an explicit unknown observation; it is not a network cancellation ACK.
senderTerminated/notApplied are trusted simulation booleans; no process or target observation is performed.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Preserve task cancellation, sender termination and effect outcome separately; authenticate and scope terminal evidence in the real adapter.
cases.catalog_title: 断连后取消不得消除未知效果

cases.mapping: authorizationRevision prevents a stale unsent reservation from passing local dispatch; no target-side monotone fencing token exists.

existing_test_evidence.name: R1-P1 a replacement active authorization cannot strand an unsent reservation

limitations: No target epoch installation, commit check or old-sender exclusion.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Require target cooperation and a separately tested fencing protocol; never rename authorizationRevision to a target fence.
cases.catalog_title: 已安装的新围栏拒绝迟到旧代际

cases.mapping: requestId deduplicates one exact command including actor and expectedRevision; duplicate task goals are rejected within this specialized merge domain.

existing_test_evidence.name: record same request retries return original receipt without another event
record journal replay retains idempotency and rejects event gaps or altered receipts

limitations: No businessIntentId/actionAttemptId split, target dedup transaction or retention contract.
Historical dispatch receipt is not a fresh permission to send again. Exact-goal de-dup is appropriate only for the stated ordinary-merge task semantics.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Define stable business intent and target namespace/parameter/retention semantics separately from command request identity.
cases.catalog_title: 幂等键的身份、参数、并发与保留期

cases.mapping: Unknown and late trusted success can update the original action; cancelled assignment remains cancelled and a successor must verify the prior result.

existing_test_evidence.name: record cancelled late success is reused through verification without another action

limitations: No actual target commit, response-drop barrier or durable action intent.
The referenced existing test was read; RF08 exercises the narrow local trajectory.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Persist the intent and preserve original effect identity; use independently authenticated target readback under a declared fault model.
cases.catalog_title: 目标已提交而本地结果丢失

cases.mapping: Action copies the current merge spec and authorization revision; final dispatch rechecks local task status, grant and specVersion.

existing_test_evidence.name: record actions are owned and task scope cannot change while a sender is unresolved

limitations: There are no actual tool arguments, resolved account/path/redirect targets or tool interception.
All user actors may perform user commands; caller authentication and actor namespace are external.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Authenticate principals and bind final effective arguments to the exact allowed resource/operation; do not treat a spec copy as interception of a real tool.
cases.catalog_title: 审批绑定最终有效动作

cases.mapping: report/note store text without changing authorization; only role-checked commands change the local grant.

existing_test_evidence.name: record reports and host attempts do not establish objective completion

limitations: actor.kind and actor.id are unverified input strings; role checking is not authentication.
Commands have no historyId field. No context restoration or current-policy service exists.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Route each authenticated command by history incarnation; maintain an authority-scoped subject identity and provide current policy outside model text.
cases.catalog_title: 历史上下文不能重建已失效授权

cases.mapping: No settled/hidden/future/reserved-cost/closing quantities or budget guard exist.
limitations: Resource reservation here is a conflict slot, not a monetary liability reservation.
The separate P13 Lean theorem does not verify S1 cost accounting.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Introduce and refine the budget protocol with honest billing and complete cost coverage before claiming either liability or hard-cap variants.
cases.catalog_title: 延迟计量期间保留未结算负担

cases.mapping: No clock, expiry, TTL, observedAt or freshness input exists in command state or judgment rules.
limitations: Event sequence is a commit ordering number, not a timestamp.
No acceptance-policy withdrawal or time-triggered re-evaluation API.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Declare explicit time/expiry semantics and relevant judgment inputs; do not infer expiry safety from deterministic replay.
cases.catalog_title: 期限跨越后的适用性重判

cases.mapping: markUnavailable updates a shared result fingerprint and invalidates current-result/current-acceptance while retaining supported completion.

existing_test_evidence.name: record revert keeps historical completion but invalidates current dependencies
R2-S03 control a revert learned through an old assignment invalidates its peer token after replay

limitations: New result.available defaults true from a historical merge observation without separate availability readback.
One global boolean cannot represent Usable_L(t,q,n), q=(consumer,operation,recipients), copies, access, purpose or disclosure.
Only identical spec+mergeSha fingerprints share availability; this is not a general artifact ontology.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Interpret S1 current-result narrowly as supported and not marked unavailable. Add independently scoped artifact/copy/consumption observations before mapping to Usable_L.
cases.catalog_title: 全局产物失效与主体访问撤回分离

cases.mapping: apply clones state, executes on draft, then synchronously publishes state/event/receipt. Replay verifies gap-free commands and receipts.

existing_test_evidence.name: record failed writes are atomic and stale task revisions cannot overwrite state
record successful action and completion publish atomically
record journal replay retains idempotency and rejects event gaps or altered receipts

limitations: Atomicity is for normal synchronous calls and validation errors; no crash persistence, external transaction or trusted storage is implemented.
Replay starts from a supplied full journal; it does not recover a lost process journal.
Journal schemaVersion=1 does not pin interpreter semantics across future code changes.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Specify a durable commit set and ACK level, interpreter/schema migration rule and failure domain; prove conflict admission and receipts survive that domain.
cases.catalog_title: 持久接纳与暂态回执区分

cases.mapping: Distinct attempts and append-only reports exist. Late action evidence targets an action ID and does not change the cancelled task to completed.

existing_test_evidence.name: record reports and host attempts do not establish objective completion
record cancelled late success is reused through verification without another action
R2-S02 a result button from another history cannot accept an independent assignment

limitations: Attempt has no specVersion, current-attempt pointer, host/environment incarnation or authority epoch.
An old attempt can reserve a newly authorized task spec with the current revision.
Cross-history token rejection is implemented only for acceptance; ordinary commands depend on adapter routing.
cases.required_refinement_obligation: Map attempt identity and authority explicitly. Retiring an attempt must not discard its late physical-effect evidence, but old attempts must not inherit new authority accidentally.
cases.catalog_title: 迟到尝试结果不覆盖当前尝试但仍可补充效果证据

must_not_infer: 20 existing tests plus 8 probes are not real-network C01-C16 conformance.
No proof of arbitrary-trace implementation simulation, authenticated identity, target truth, durable storage or physical exactly-once effects.
Frozen input hashes identify each working draft separately from the shared git HEAD.
